function.arguments: {"command": "cd ~/data; awk -F, 'NR>1{c[$2]++; if($5!~/^-?[0-9]+$/||$6!~/^-?[0-9.]+$/||NF!=6)print \"bad\",NR,$0}END{for(r in c)print r,c[r]}' sales_2026.csv; grep -c $'\\r' sales_2026.csv"}

function.name: bash
function.arguments: {"command": "cd ~/data; mkdir -p ~/out; awk -F, 'NR>1{r[$2]+=$5*$6}END{print \"region,revenue\";for(k in r)printf \"%s,%.2f\\n\",k,r[k]}' sales_2026.csv | (read h; echo \"$h\"; sort -t, -k2,2nr) > ~/out/region_totals.csv; cat ~/out/region_totals.csv; awk -F, '$5<=0||$6<=0' sales_2026.csv | head"}
